judgment.quote_A: I kindly request that you send the revised table by Thursday, at 3 pm.
judgment.quote_B: To ensure we meet our project timeline, I kindly request that you send the revised table by this coming Thursday at 3 PM.
judgment.reason: Answer A meets the 80-word limit (73 words), preserves the deadline (Thursday at 3 pm), the request (send revised table), and the requirement to update today if impossible, without inventing reasons. Answer B exceeds the word limit (82 words), invents a reason ('To ensure we meet our project timeline'), and weakens the 'today' requirement to 'at your earliest convenience.'
